Auntie Ethel is a fussy trader of potions, lotions, quirks, and sundries who can be first encountered in The Hollow of the Emerald Grove. Later, she returns to her home at the Riverside Teahouse in the Sunlit Wetlands.
“
Bollocks. You were supposed to rush to my defence, love. Fat lot of good you are. Some advice? You ever darken my door, you'd best have that head bowed and an apology at the ready. Bye-bye, now!
„
— Auntie Ethel, dropping her mask

Involvement

Act One

In the Druid Grove

Auntie Ethel can first be found in The Hollow in the Emerald Grove, peddling "Potions and Lotions" to the Tiefling refugees. Upon first speaking, she quickly notices something is awry with the interacting party member and invites them to visit her at her home, the Riverside Teahouse.

While in the Emerald Grove she also acts as a trader. Once the party reach the Sunlit Wetlands, Auntie Ethel moves from the Emerald Grove and appears in the Wetlands, and then eventually at the Teahouse.

If a party member first[1] speaks with  Pandirna before Ethel, she tells them Auntie Ethel gave her a potion to make her "strong and brave as a bugbear," but left her paralyzed instead. Immediately following this interaction, Auntie Ethel leaves her shop in the Emerald Grove.

If Ethel is attacked or successfully pickpocketed while in the Emerald Grove, she exclaims, "Blast it all! I'm going home." and leaves for the Riverside Teahouse. The same result occurs if a  hiding character is spotted by her.

Auntie Ethel leaves the grove permanently once the conversation between her and  Mayrina's brothers happens in the Sunlit Wetlands (see below).

In the Sunlit Wetlands

When the party first enter the Sunlit Wetlands from the east,  Johl and his brother  Demir are arguing with Auntie Ethel, demanding she tell them where their sister Mayrina is, and accuse Ethel of having taken her. This starts ⁠Save Mayrina.

The party can talk with the group to learn more: Mayrina has disappeared and the last person to see her was Ethel. Throughout the encounter, Demir pleads with her while she insists she is blameless, but "willing to help" them look for her.

Eventually, the party can choose to take either side, or none at all. They can even walk right past, ignoring the trio altogether. If they side with Auntie Ethel, Demir and Johl accuse the party of working with her and attack. If they do not side with Ethel, she chastises them and disappears in a burst of magic. The party can then talk to the two brothers and attempt to convince them not to follow her into the swamp, which is futile.

In the Riverside Teahouse

If the party enter the Teahouse, they observe Auntie Ethel forcing  Mayrina to eat. If the player character ⁠seeks Ethel's help to remove the tadpole, she states her price: they must give up an eye in exchange for her removing the Tadpole.

If the player character accepts her bargain, she reverts to her hag form, asks them to choose which eye to surrender and begins the procedure to remove the tadpole, only to soon stop and (truthfully) declare it has been modified by ancient Netherese magic. Having already  Paid the Price, she refuses to reverse it despite failing to cure the player character. Allowing Auntie Ethel to take an eye of the player character irrevocably changes the appearance of the chosen eye. It cannot be removed and its appearance does not change with the Magic Mirror. It is not possible to take this deal if  Volo has already replaced one of the player character's  eyes or  Wyll is chosen as origin.

If the player character does not accept her bargain, and instead insists on saving Mayrina, then Ethel eventually reveals her true form and starts a fight, calling the  redcaps from outside the teahouse to her side. During the fight Ethel first consumes a  Potion of Invisibility, and then disappears through her fireplace in the teahouse.

To save Mayrina the party must follow Ethel and infiltrate her lair in the Overgrown Tunnel.[2] In her lair, victims and thralls of the hag are found. Some of them can be freed, while others must usually be fought and are lost forever.

Eventually Mayrina is seen in a cage in the Ancient Abode and can by saved by defeating Ethel. Alternatively it is possible to make a deal with Ethel, to acquire  Auntie Ethel's Hair after which she disappears.

Act Three

In the Blushing Mermaid

Auntie Ethel is part of the ⁠Help the Hag Survivors, ⁠Avenge the Hag Survivors, and ⁠Save Vanra questlines whether the party accept her offer or kill her. She can be found posing as  Captain Grisly in The Blushing Mermaid in Lower City. Her lair is located under this tavern and can be infiltrated through the basement. Auntie Ethel does not appear in Act Three if she remained in her lair at the Sunlit Wetlands and did not abandon it.

It is ultimately revealed that Ethel is functionally unkillable while her life force is invested in her magic mushrooms, which is how can survived being killed in Act One. If she is killed there, she is more hostile to the party, preventing them from demanding a counter-offer to leave her alone. However, this does not prevent her from being acquired as an Ally for ⁠Gather Your Allies if Lora is killed and Auntie Ethel is left to her schemes.

It is recommended to begin the quest ⁠Save Vanra by speaking with  Lora prior to completing the Hag Survivors questlines and defeating the Hag. Failure to get this quest from Lora directly, even if  Vanra is saved, locks the party out of its quest rewards.

Killing Auntie Ethel in Act Three grants the following inspiration:

  • ⁠Estrangement of Ethel ( Urchin background)
  • ⁠Double-Tap ( Soldier background) - for killing her a second time
  • ⁠Re-tasting the Kill ( Haunted One background)

Speak with Dead

If killed, Ethel's body can be spoken to using  Speak with Dead. Ethel is unique in that her Speak with Dead dialogue changes depending on whether she still has the  Tarnished Charm on her corpse when talking to her. Unlike most corpses, she is willing (but angry) to speak to her killer.

With Tarnished Charm

  • Narrator
    *A charm on the hag's body flashes a faint glow.*
  • Auntie Ethel
    ARGH. You knuckle-dragging gobshite.
  • Auntie Ethel
    You will bleed - you will choke on your own guts for this. (if the caster is Ethel's killer)
  • Auntie Ethel
    ARGH. Where is the knuckle-dragging gobshite that killed me? (if the caster is not Ethel's killer)
  • You're quite lively for a corpse.
    • Auntie Ethel
      I'm a hag, you little snot - you think I didn't plan for this? Death and I are old friends.
    • Auntie Ethel
      But I won't be a corpse forever - that I can bloody promise you.
  • Tell me the truth - what did you want with Mayrina?
    • Auntie Ethel
      I didn't want the girl, sweetie. I wanted her babe.
    • Auntie Ethel
      I would have gobbled it up and given birth to my very own hag daughter.
    • Auntie Ethel
      From my guts she would've come - my blood, my bile. It would have been glorious.
  • Does being dead bother you? (if the caster is not Ethel's killer))
    • Auntie Ethel
      You think this is the first time? I've found my way back before, and I will again.
    • Auntie Ethel
      And then I will make the cretin beg, plead, weep for what will always be denied...
    • Auntie Ethel
      ...The sweet release of death.
  • You're dead and I'm not. Deal with it. (if the caster is Ethel's killer)
    • Auntie Ethel
      For now.
  • Why are you so cruel?
    • Auntie Ethel
      Please. It's you lot who come to me. All you do is want - to be prettier, to be richer, to be loved.
    • Auntie Ethel
      People are their own worst enemies, petal. I just let them see it.
  • What deal did you make with Mayrina?
    • Auntie Ethel
      The brat's husband is dead. So sad.
    • Auntie Ethel
      She wanted me to bring him back to life. Little fool thought it would fix everything.
  • Do you have any regrets? (if the caster is not Ethel's killer)
    • Auntie Ethel
      Only one.
    • Auntie Ethel
      And you'll never know.
  • Do you have any regrets? (if the caster is Ethel's killer)
    • Auntie Ethel
      Only that I don't get to see the flesh melt from your bones, your guts dissolve, and your brain liquefy as you turn into a mind flayer.
    • Auntie Ethel
      You'll weep, you'll beg, you'll plead - anything to make it stop. And once you stand tall, proud and tentacled?
    • Auntie Ethel
      You'll butcher your friends and your loved ones LIKE THE ILLITHID SCUM YOU ARE.

Without Tarnished Charm

  • Auntie Ethel
    Bleed... choke on... your guts... (if the caster is Ethel's killer)
  • Auntie Ethel
    Kill them... kill them... all... (if the caster is not Ethel's killer)
  • Why did you want Mayrina?
    • Auntie Ethel
      Didn't want... the girl... wanted her... babe.
    • Auntie Ethel
      ... was going to... eat it... and make a... hag daughter...
  • Are you the only hag around here?
    • Auntie Ethel
      Where there's people... there's... hags.
  • Where do you keep your valuables?
    • Auntie Ethel
      In my... workroom...
  • Why are you so cruel?
    • Auntie Ethel
      Not me... that's cruel. It's... people.
    • Auntie Ethel
      They want... and want... and want. I merely... give.

Notes and references

  1. ↑ Padirna is initially located in the storage house next to the Emerald Grove jail. Her location later changes if she survives the raiding of the Emerald Grove.
  2. ↑ It is possible to kill Auntie Ethel before she escapes into the Overgrown Tunnel with enough damage. The spell  Command is very helpful in this. However, if she is killed before the cut-scene in her lair,  Auntie Ethel's Hair cannot be obtained.
